summary: The Gray crowned Rosy Finch (Aves finch) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits temperate and subtropical woodlands, grasslands, and wetlands, where its diet consists primarily of insects, seeds, grains, berries, and small invertebrates.
